name: g0-check
description: step G0 books check: 400 s at MAX (seed 5), whole dish lit, perfusion on; every G0 switch off and on again (stir, split, ceiling, cost, breaks, null), a squeeze 0.8 and a stretch 1.25, the press, a resize, a snapshot saved and loaded: atoms and charge rounding must stay 0
